(()=>{const d=new Date();const p=n=>String(n).padStart(2,'0');const ymd=d.getFullYear()+'-'+p(d.getMonth()+1)+'-'+p(d.getDate());const set=(s,v)=>{const e=document.querySelector(s);if(!e)return;e.readOnly=false;e.value=v;e.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));};const pickv=(s,v)=>{const e=document.querySelector(s);if(!e)return;const o=[...e.options].find(x=>x.value===v);if(!o)throw new Error(s+' 에 코드 '+v+' 없음');e.value=v;e.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));};set("#END_YMD",ymd);pickv('#END_CD_TIME',p(d.getHours()));pickv('#END_CD_MINUTE','00');})()

(()=>{const e=document.querySelector("#CD_DONE");if(!e)throw new Error('콤보 없음: '+"#CD_DONE");const p="";let o=null;if(p)o=[...e.options].find(x=>x.value===p||x.text.includes(p));if(!o)o=[...e.options].find(x=>x.value!==''&&!/선택|전체/.test(x.text));if(!o)throw new Error('선택할 옵션 없음: '+"#CD_DONE"+' ['+[...e.options].map(x=>x.value+':'+x.text).join(',')+']');e.value=o.value;e.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));})()

(()=>{const v="SIT 종결 의견(자동)";const e=document.querySelector("#END_CONT");if(!e)throw new Error('입력칸 없음: '+"#END_CONT");e.readOnly=false;e.disabled=false;e.value=v;e.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));e.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));})()

(()=>{const m="SIT 자동 테스트";const vis=e=>!!(e.offsetWidth||e.offsetHeight);const ymd=(()=>{const d=new Date();return d.getFullYear()+'-'+String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');})();document.querySelectorAll('[metaessential="1"]').forEach(e=>{if(!vis(e)||e.readOnly||e.disabled)return;const id=e.id||'';if(e.tagName==='SELECT'){if(!e.value){const o=[...e.options].find(x=>x.value!==''&&!/선택|전체/.test(x.text));if(o){e.value=o.value;e.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));}}}else if(e.type==='radio'){const g=document.querySelectorAll('input[type=radio][name="'+e.name+'"]');if(![...g].some(x=>x.checked))g[0].click();}else if(e.type==='checkbox'){}else if(e.tagName==='TEXTAREA'){if(!e.value.trim()){e.value=m;e.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));}}else if(e.tagName==='INPUT'&&!e.value.trim()){let v=m;if(/YMD|DT_|DATE/i.test(id))v=ymd;if(/TIME|HH/i.test(id))v='10';if(/MINUTE|MI$/i.test(id))v='00';e.value=v;e.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));}});})()
